description.value: Akasaka Japanese Restaurant is a long-running Japanese eatery in Pitt Meadows operating out of a historic heritage building, trading on the tagline 'Old House, Fresh Sushi.' The menu spans sushi, tempura, noodles, donburi, and appetizers with both dine-in and takeout options. A private dining room accommodating groups of 5 to 30 or more makes it a practical stop for cycling clubs or post-ride gatherings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms a fully operating dine-in and takeout Japanese restaurant at 19175 122 Ave, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2E9, matching the OSM address. The 'Take Out Menu' and 'Orders To Go' sections confirm takeout service; vegetarian menu items (Vege Croquettes, Sweet Potato Croquettes, Agedashi Tofu, Edamame) confirm vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those are null.
concerns: Website copyright footer reads '© 2013 KSODESIGN' suggesting the site has not been updated in many years; content may be stale.
Phone number is listed in OSM but does not appear in the scraped website text, so it could not be confirmed from the website.

Website references 'McMyn Massion House' and a 'Coquitlam Community' program, which is geographically inconsistent with the Pitt Meadows address — possibly a heritage tenancy or community partnership arrangement worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating restaurant in Pitt Meadows with an active website, full menu, and confirmed address — straightforward inclusion as a food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The restaurant appears to occupy or be affiliated with the McMyn House heritage property in Pitt Meadows. The full postal code V3Y 2E9 was obtained from the website contact page and added to the OSM-sourced address.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Takeout menu lists multiple vegetarian items: Vege Croquettes, Sweet Potato Croquettes, Agedashi Tofu, Spicy Agedashi Tofu, Edamame, and Rice. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found

Packed lunches.detail: 'Lunch Box' and 'Dinner Box' are listed as distinct takeout menu categories, indicating pre-packaged meal boxes are available to go

wow_evidence: long-running Japanese eatery ... historic heritage building
